question: Why is pregabalin short, and what do we do?

steps.title: Our stock in three hospitals
steps.purpose: Read on-hand stock and 28-day use where each hospital keeps it.

steps.title: Where our supply is made
steps.purpose: Follow each product's label to the plants it names, and place each plant in FDA's registration file.
steps.finding: 1 plant links on 1 labels; 1 placed in FDA's registration file.

steps.title: What FDA says about this shortage
steps.purpose: Read FDA's current shortage list and its history for this drug.
steps.finding: Not on FDA's current shortage list.

steps.title: Who else makes it

steps.title: What FDA found at those plants
steps.purpose: Read every FDA drug inspection, warning letter, import alert and recall for these plants.
steps.finding: 9 inspections (1 OAI at our plants), 1 compliance actions, 0 import-alert listings, 0 recalls.

steps.title: What FDA wrote at the OAI inspections
steps.purpose: Read the Form 483 observations recorded at those inspections.

steps.title: What our P&T committee already approved
steps.purpose: Read Corvale General's approved interchanges for these items.

steps.title: Which links can't be trusted
steps.purpose: Run the semantic layer's foreign-key rules over each hospital's stock, and name the rows they reject.
steps.finding: 12 stock rows across the system fail the NDC rule; 0 of them are this drug.

explanation.headline: FDA's records trace this shortage to a plant on our own labels

sentences.text: Our pregabalin supply is labeled by Bryant Ranch Prepack, a registered plant with FEI 1000519407.
FDA inspection 590126 of that plant ended on 2009-06-11 and was classified OAI, with the classification known on 2009-09-09.
A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2010-04-08.
Subsequent inspections from 2010 through 2026-07-16 were classified VAI.
Corvale East has 43 days on hand, Corvale General has 26 days, and Corvale Lakeside has 19 days.

rejected.text: That OAI classification occurred 6227 days before the posting date of 2026-10-21.
rejected.reason: date 2026-10-21 is not in the cited evidence

rejected.text: The best option by rule is to buy from A-S Medication Solutions, which is not on FDA's shortage list today and its label names no plant we could place.
FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 6227 days before the posting
rejected.reason: headline: number 6227 is not in the cited evidence

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Q-9e1833.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%pregabalin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%pregabalin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-4c0e21.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('47cc53e6-e679-4a01-babc-af301dd756f7') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-4359be.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%pregabalin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-f5688b.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%pregabalin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-9c6c7f.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%pregabalin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%capsule%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-cb1e99.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-911252.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-f91367.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1000519407') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-4a3178.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('bryant ranch prepack') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%pregabalin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-7ba5bd.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('590126') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-11128e.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('72162154809')

Q-fd912d.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%pregabalin%'
